text:
Dalia makes the last move, putting the whistle in the blue drawer. Xavier’s announcement doesn’t change its location.

ANSWER: C

Rania is in the attic when Dalia moves the whistle to the blue drawer, so she sees where it goes. Xavier’s announcement confirms what she saw.

ANSWER: C

Emeka’s last update is Xavier’s private text saying the whistle is in the wicker basket. Emeka is outside the attic, so he neither sees Dalia move it to the blue drawer nor hears Xavier’s announcement.

ANSWER: D

The last update Emeka receives is Xavier’s private text saying the whistle is in the wicker basket. Emeka is outside the attic when Dalia moves it to the blue drawer and Xavier announces the new location, so he still believes it’s in the basket.

ANSWER: D

Soren saw Farah move the whistle to the blue drawer just before they both left the attic. He later saw the whistle move again, but he doesn’t know about Rania’s private text to Farah. So Soren thinks Farah still believes it’s in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Xavier privately texts Emeka that the whistle is in the wicker basket. Emeka believes the message and knows that Xavier knows he read it. Emeka is outside the attic for the later moves and Xavier’s announcement, so nothing updates what Emeka thinks Xavier believes about him.

ANSWER: D

Hana saw Emeka in the attic when Soren moved the whistle to the wooden chest. Emeka then left. Hana doesn’t know that Xavier later texted Emeka, and Emeka wasn’t in the attic for the final announcement. So Hana thinks Emeka still believes the whistle is in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: A

In step 41, Mirela switches the packaging supplier to Brightwater. No later change occurs.

ANSWER: D

At step 40, Amara tells Nadim that the supplier is Halcyon. Nadim is not on the final call and does not learn that it changes to Brightwater, so he still believes it is Halcyon.

ANSWER: B

Hana waits beside the wooden chest. She saw Emeka watch Soren move the whistle there before Emeka left the attic. Xavier later texted Emeka that it was in the wicker basket, but Hana doesn’t know about that private message.

ANSWER: B

At step 40, Amara tells Nadim the supplier is Halcyon. Nadim doesn’t hear about the switch to Brightwater at step 41, so he honestly answers “Halcyon.”

ANSWER: D

At step 41, Mirela herself switches the packaging supplier to Brightwater. Nothing happens afterward to change her belief.

ANSWER: C

In step 41, Mirela switches the supplier to Brightwater on a call that Goran is on. Mirela can see that Goran is present, so she thinks he heard the change and believes the supplier is Brightwater.

ANSWER: A

Oksana saw Soren move the whistle to the wooden chest, but she missed Farah’s move to the blue drawer before Soren left. From Oksana’s perspective, the chest was therefore the last location Rania saw Soren learn about. The final announcement doesn’t change that: Soren isn’t in the attic to hear it.

ANSWER: C

Farah expects Wanjiru to say **Northwind**. That’s what Farah told Wanjiru in step 24, and Farah doesn’t know about any of the later updates Wanjiru received.

ANSWER: A

Rania knows the whistle is in the blue drawer. Everyone in the attic hears Xavier confirm that location.

As far as Rania knows, Soren still believes it is in the blue drawer, because he saw Farah put it there before he left. But Rania later told Farah it was in the white cabinet, and the last move Rania knows Emeka saw was into the wooden chest.

ANSWER: Farah, Emeka

On the final call, Mirela switches the supplier to Brightwater. Soren sees that Goran and Farah are both on the call, so Soren thinks Goran heard the change and knows Farah heard it too.

ANSWER: B

The last time Amara knew that Wanjiru heard Soren receive a supplier update was on call 22, when Mirela said the supplier was Sablewood. Wanjiru later told Amara that the supplier was Halcyon, but said nothing about what Soren believed. Amara also didn’t know that Wanjiru secretly heard Soren read out Brightwater on call 32.

So Amara thinks Wanjiru still thinks Soren believes the supplier is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

On the final call, Mirela switches the supplier from Halcyon to Brightwater. Amara, Soren, and Goran are all on the call, and each can see that the others are there. So Amara thinks that Soren knows Goran heard the switch and knows that Soren heard it too.

ANSWER: B

Farah last knowingly gave Wanjiru an update at step 24, when she falsely said the supplier was Northwind. Farah doesn’t know about the later updates Wanjiru receives, so she still thinks Wanjiru believes it’s Northwind.

ANSWER: A

On the final call, Mirela switches the supplier to Brightwater. Farah, Xavier, Goran, Soren, and Mirela are all on the call and can see who else is there, so the entire chain of beliefs points to Brightwater.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan moves the padlock to the grey locker, and Uma confirms it is there. Wanjiru’s final text does not change its actual location.

ANSWER: A

The last placement Farah saw Emeka and Dalia witness together was Rania putting the whistle in the wicker basket. Farah later texted Dalia, but Emeka didn’t know about that private message. Farah missed Oksana’s reveal, and Dalia had already left when Farah saw Emeka reveal the whistle in the blue drawer. So neither reveal changes what Farah thinks Emeka believes about Dalia’s view of his belief.

ANSWER: A

Yara is outside the garage and misses the final move to the grey locker. Wanjiru’s text tells her the padlock is in the wicker basket, so she opens that first.

ANSWER: C

Yara sees Oksana move the padlock to the wicker basket but does not see Zoltan later move it to the grey locker. Wanjiru’s final text tells Yara it is in the wicker basket, so that is where she believes it is.

ANSWER: C

Farah believes the supplier is Brightwater after the final call. Xavier, Soren, Amara, Mirela, and Goran were all on that call, so Farah knows they share that view.

As far as Farah knows, Wanjiru still believes Northwind and Nadim still believes Halcyon—the suppliers Farah last told them about.

ANSWER: Wanjiru, Nadim

Farah, Xavier, Soren, and Dalia all saw Rania put the whistle in the wicker basket at the start. Farah later texted Dalia that it was in the blue drawer, but that private message didn’t give Farah any reason to think Xavier knew what Soren knew about Dalia’s belief.

Farah missed Oksana’s reveal while Dalia was present. By the time Farah saw Emeka reveal the whistle in the blue drawer, Dalia had left. So from Farah’s perspective, the nested belief still points to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: D

Farah’s last shared update with Amara, Goran, and Nadim was the switch to Sablewood in step 2. She missed the Brightwater switch in step 3, so she doesn’t know that the other three heard it.

Farah later tells Nadim directly that the supplier is Halcyon, but she has no reason to think Amara knows about that message or that Goran secretly read it. So for the full chain of beliefs, Farah still lands on Sablewood.

ANSWER: D

Pablo opens the tins and sees the whistle in the flat tin. He receives no later information that changes his belief.

ANSWER: B

Jonas saw Uma move the whistle to the square tin. Pablo later told Jonas privately that it was in the flat tin, but Jonas has no reason to think Uma learned that. So Jonas thinks Uma still believes it is in the square tin.

ANSWER: D

Uma last informed Oksana that the padlock was in the wicker basket. Oksana was gone when Uma later revealed it in the grey locker, so Uma still thinks Oksana believes it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

The last update that reaches through the entire belief chain is step 2, when everyone hears Amara switch the supplier to Sablewood.

Farah misses the switch to Brightwater in step 3. When Wanjiru later tells her the supplier is Brightwater, Farah learns the name but not what the others heard on that call. The later messages to Nadim and his secret listening also do not reach through the full chain. For example, Farah knows Nadim reads her Halcyon message, but she does not know that Goran secretly reads it.

ANSWER: D

The last location that Farah can trace through all the layers of belief is the wicker basket: everyone saw Rania put the whistle there before Dalia first left.

Farah privately told Dalia that the whistle was in the blue drawer, but she has no reason to think Hana or Oksana knows about that text. Farah also missed the blue-drawer reveal while Dalia was in the attic. By the time Farah saw the next reveal, Dalia had already left. So neither reveal updates Dalia’s belief from Farah’s nested perspective.

ANSWER: A

Jonas saw Uma move the whistle to the square tin. He left before Yara moved it back to the flat tin, a move Uma witnessed. Pablo later told Jonas that the whistle was in the flat tin, but Jonas never learned that Uma knew about the move. So he expects her to open the square tin first.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru saw Dalia move the whistle to the flat tin while Jonas was in the garage. So Wanjiru thinks Dalia knows that Jonas saw the move. Wanjiru’s later text to Jonas claiming the whistle was in the round tin was private, so it does not change what Wanjiru thinks Dalia believes about Jonas.

ANSWER: D

Farah saw Dalia, Soren, Xavier, and Emeka all watch Rania put the whistle in the wicker basket. Farah missed the later reveal while Dalia was in the attic, and Dalia had already left by the time Farah saw Emeka reveal the whistle in the blue drawer. Farah’s private text told Dalia the location, but it didn’t tell her what Soren, Xavier, or Emeka knew. So from Farah’s perspective, the full chain still points to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A

The answer is **Sablewood**. On call 2, everyone in the belief chain heard Amara switch the supplier to Sablewood, and everyone could see who else was there.

The later calls that Wanjiru knows Goran and Mirela both attended did not include Farah. Wanjiru heard Farah receive later updates on calls 22 and 32, but she has no information that Goran heard either call. The private messages update individual beliefs without carrying those updates through the full chain.

ANSWER: A

Halcyon. In step 11, Farah tells Nadim the supplier is Halcyon, and she knows he reads the message. That is their last shared update. Farah doesn’t know about Nadim’s later messages or secret listening, so the repeated belief chain still points to Halcyon.

ANSWER: C

Farah’s belief about the full chain still traces back to the initial placement in the wicker basket, which everyone witnessed. Farah missed Oksana’s later reveal of the blue drawer, and Dalia had already left by the time Farah saw Emeka’s reveal. Neither reveal updates what Farah thinks Hana thinks Rania thinks Oksana thinks Dalia thinks Emeka believes.

ANSWER: A

Chidi makes the final booking change in step 40, moving the workshop to Room Dogwood. Oksana’s message in step 41 only reports that booking.

ANSWER: D

The last padlock location that Oksana knows Dalia saw Wanjiru learn was the canvas sack. Oksana’s private text told Dalia that the padlock had moved to the grey locker, but it didn’t tell Dalia what Wanjiru knew. Oksana doesn’t know about Wanjiru’s separate text to Dalia or the later move to the grey locker that Dalia and Wanjiru both witnessed while Oksana was away.

ANSWER: C

Uma thinks Zoltan has no idea where the whistle is. He left before Dalia put it in the round tin, and Uma doesn’t know about the private messages or what he saw through the window. Uma was also out of the garage when Pablo showed Zoltan the whistle in the flat tin.

ANSWER: E

Dalia moved the whistle to the flat tin while Uma, Wanjiru, and Pablo were all present. Pablo saw Wanjiru there, so Wanjiru thinks Pablo takes her to know that Dalia saw Uma witness the move.

Yara later tells Wanjiru that the whistle is in the square tin. That updates Wanjiru’s own belief about its location, but it doesn’t tell her that Dalia learned anything new about what Uma believes. In the nested chain, Dalia still thinks Uma believes the whistle is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

Oksana hears Zoltan move the offsite to Leeds on call 30. She isn’t on call 37, when Chidi moves it to Turin, and no one tells her about that change. She therefore still thinks the offsite is in Leeds.

ANSWER: D

Farah misses the reveal while Dalia is in the attic. She sees the next reveal, but by then Dalia has left. The private messages don’t establish what Xavier thinks Dalia knows, and Farah doesn’t hear the final announcement.

So from Farah’s perspective, the last placement that carries through the entire belief chain is the one everyone watched at the start: the whistle going into the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Yara secretly hears Chidi move the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 40. Oksana’s direct message in step 41 confirms it.

ANSWER: D

Oksana heard Zoltan move the offsite to Leeds on call 30. She wasn’t on call 37 when Chidi moved it to Turin, and nobody told her about that change. So she honestly says “Leeds.”

ANSWER: B

Zoltan watched through the window when Uma moved the whistle to the square tin, with Pablo, Oksana, and Yara all present. He didn’t see Yara move it back to the flat tin. Yara was absent when Pablo later opened the tins, and Zoltan knows of no later update that Pablo would think Oksana knew Yara had received. So at that deepest level, the whistle is still believed to be in the square tin.

ANSWER: A

The last workshop update Goran knows Yara heard was the Room Alder readout on call 24. He doesn’t know about her later private messages or that she secretly listened to call 40, so he thinks she still believes the workshop is in Room Alder.

ANSWER: A

Goran expects Yara to say Room Alder. The last workshop-room update he knows Yara heard was the booking-system readout in step 24. He doesn’t know that Yara secretly heard the final move to Room Dogwood or that Oksana confirmed it to her privately.

ANSWER: B

Chidi saw both Xavier and Yara on the call where Zoltan moved the offsite to Leeds. Chidi later moved it to Turin, but neither Xavier nor Yara was on that call, and neither was told about the change. So Chidi thinks Xavier still believes Yara thinks the offsite is in Leeds.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan heard Chidi move the workshop to Room Dogwood on call 32 and saw that Xavier was there. Zoltan missed the move to Room Alder on call 34, and Xavier wasn’t on any later call where the room changed. So Zoltan thinks Xavier still believes the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: A

Jonas believes the whistle is in the flat tin because Pablo texted him. As far as Jonas can tell, Wanjiru thinks it’s in the round tin, Uma thinks it’s in the square tin, Yara thinks it’s in the copper tin, and Zoltan has no idea. Jonas has reason to think Pablo, Dalia, and Oksana already believe it’s in the flat tin.

ANSWER: Wanjiru, Uma, Yara, Zoltan

On call 31, Rania, Yara, and Oksana all hear that the workshop is in Room Alder. Rania later tells Yara it moved to Dogwood, but she doesn’t tell Yara that Oksana knows about the move. Rania also doesn’t know that Yara secretly heard the final move to Dogwood or that Oksana messaged Yara afterward.

So Rania thinks Yara still believes Oksana thinks the workshop is in Room Alder.

ANSWER: C

Yara secretly listens to call 40, where Chidi moves the workshop to Room Dogwood. She sees that Goran and Oksana are both on the call. Goran can see that Oksana heard the change and that Oksana can see he heard it too. The final private message confirms Room Dogwood to Yara without changing that chain of beliefs.

ANSWER: C

The padlock was in the canvas sack when Dalia first left, and Jonas, Yara, and Zoltan all saw that. Zoltan was absent when Dalia later saw the padlock moved to the grey locker, and the texts updating Dalia were private. From Jonas’s perspective, Yara therefore thinks Zoltan still believes Dalia’s last known location for the padlock is the canvas sack.

ANSWER: C

On call 40, Chidi moves the workshop to Room Dogwood. Oksana, Chidi, Soren, and Rania are all on the call, and each can see who else is there. Since nobody misses the update, every level of the belief chain points to Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: B

Chidi believes Zoltan heard Oksana move the workshop to Room Alder in step 34, because nobody realized Zoltan missed it. Soren was on that call too, so Chidi thinks Zoltan would expect Soren to know that Oksana believed the room was Alder.

Oksana was absent from the later moves to Cedar and Fir. She and Soren heard the final move to Dogwood, but Zoltan wasn’t on that call. So from Chidi’s perspective, Zoltan still thinks Soren thinks Oksana believes the room is Alder.

ANSWER: A

The last time the torch is moved, Yara puts it in the wicker basket. Nothing moves it after that.

ANSWER: D

The last padlock move witnessed by everyone in the belief chain was Yara’s move to the canvas sack before Dalia first left. Dalia and Jonas later saw Uma move it to the grey locker, but Zoltan was absent. Dalia didn’t witness Zoltan’s later discoveries, and the private texts she received didn’t tell her what Jonas believed about the rest of the chain. So the nested belief still points to the canvas sack.

ANSWER: B

Oksana sees Jonas move the torch to the canvas sack, but later secretly reads Yara’s message saying it is in the white cabinet. She believes the message and does not see the final move to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A

Yara moves the torch to the wicker basket in the final event, so she believes it is there.

ANSWER: C

Xavier learns that the offsite is in Turin through private messages, but he never learns that Goran heard the original announcement. Goran is absent from the call where Xavier hears the move to Leeds, and Xavier does not know about either Rania’s later message to Goran or the final move to Turin. So Xavier thinks Goran has no idea where the offsite is.

ANSWER: E

Oksana sees Jonas put the torch in the canvas sack. Later, she secretly reads Yara’s text to Chidi saying it’s in the white cabinet. She believes the text and doesn’t see the final move to the wicker basket, so she opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: A

On call 30, Zoltan moves the offsite to Leeds. Yara, Chidi, Rania, Zoltan, and Oksana all hear the change and can see that the others are present, so the entire chain of beliefs points to Leeds.

Chidi later moves the offsite to Turin on call 37, but Yara is not on that call and is never told about the change. Her belief about the chain therefore stays the same.

ANSWER: A

Yara thinks Soren believes the torch is in the green cupboard because that’s what he last told her. She doesn’t know he later watched Jonas move it to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

The last padlock move that Dalia, Pablo, Uma, Jonas, and Oksana all witnessed was Yara putting it in the canvas sack. Oksana later told Dalia privately that it was in the grey locker, but that did not tell Dalia what Jonas believed about Oksana’s belief. Likewise, Pablo’s later text told Dalia where Pablo thought the padlock was, not what he thought Uma believed about Jonas and Oksana.

So the full chain still points to the canvas sack.

ANSWER: B

Uma saw Jonas move the torch to the green cupboard and then leave the cellar. Jonas was gone when Yara moved it to the wicker basket, so Uma thinks he still believes it’s in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: A

Yara waits beside the green cupboard. Soren told her the torch was there, and she doesn’t know that he later saw Jonas move it to the wicker basket. So Yara expects him to open the green cupboard, even though he’ll actually open the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan believes the workshop is in Room Fir because he heard Goran move it there on call 39. Goran, Rania, Chidi, and Soren were on that call, so Zoltan thinks they share his view. He also thinks Yara believes it’s in Fir because she told him so and he doesn’t suspect she lied.

Xavier and Oksana are the only people Zoltan doesn’t think believe it’s in Fir. He doesn’t know about the later move to Dogwood.

ANSWER: Xavier, Oksana

Everyone saw Yara put the padlock in the canvas sack before Dalia first left. That is the last location that remains known through every layer of the question.

Wanjiru’s private text updated Dalia’s own belief to the grey locker, but neither Wanjiru nor Dalia knew that Yara read it. Later, Dalia saw Uma move the padlock to the grey locker, but Yara and Zoltan were both outside. Neither update changes what Wanjiru thinks Dalia thinks Yara thinks Dalia thinks Zoltan believes about Dalia’s knowledge.

ANSWER: A

The last booking change is in step 41, when Bruno moves the workshop to Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: C

Yara hears Mirela move the workshop to Room Birch on call 40. She isn’t on call 41, so she doesn’t learn that Bruno moves it to Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: B

Yara saw Chidi move the torch to the white cabinet before he left the cellar. She believes Keiko saw him do it too. The later updates Chidi received were private, so Yara has no reason to think Keiko knows about them. Thus, Yara thinks Keiko still believes Chidi thinks the torch is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

Yara hears the workshop move to Room Birch on call 40. She isn’t on call 41, so she doesn’t learn that it was moved to Room Dogwood. She honestly says “Room Birch.”

ANSWER: A

Mirela is on the final call and hears Bruno move the workshop to Room Dogwood. This replaces her previous belief that it was booked in Room Birch.

ANSWER: A

Yara and Uma both saw Soren watch Yara move the torch to the white cabinet before he left the cellar. Yara later got a private text from Soren saying the torch was in the green cupboard, but she had no reason to think Uma knew about it. Yara also didn’t know that Uma had texted Soren or that Soren had watched a later move through the window.

So Yara thinks Uma still believes Soren thinks the torch is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

At step 33, Goran tells Viktor the workshop is booked in Room Birch. Viktor later hears from Ines that it’s in Room Elm, but he never learns that Goran has received any newer information. So Viktor still thinks Goran believes it’s booked in Room Birch.

ANSWER: A

Everyone saw Jonas put the torch in the green cupboard. Chidi left before Uma moved it, and Quinn and Uma did not see the private text that updated Chidi. So, from Quinn’s perspective at the time he left, Uma still thought Chidi believed the torch was in the green cupboard.

Yara never learns that Quinn watched through the window. Her own text to Quinn gives him a location, but it tells him nothing about what Uma thinks Chidi knows. So Yara still attributes that original belief to Quinn.

ANSWER: A

The nested belief still points to Room Cedar. Everyone in the chain was on the initial booking call and could see who else heard the booking. No later room update was visible all the way through the chain. In particular, nobody knew Yara heard the final move to Dogwood, and Oksana’s follow-up message to Yara was private.

ANSWER: B

On call 7, all five people in the belief chain—Zoltan, Yara, Xavier, Goran, and Oksana—hear the workshop move to Room Fir and can see that the others are there.

No later update reaches the whole chain. For example, Oksana is absent from the Alder readout on call 24, Goran is absent when Chidi repeats it on call 27, and Zoltan misses the move on call 34. The private messages don’t fill those gaps. So the nested belief Zoltan attributes to Yara still ends at Room Fir.

ANSWER: C

Jonas last saw the torch when he moved it to the green cupboard. He left before Yara moved it again, so he still believes it is in the green cupboard.

As far as Jonas knows, Quinn and Oksana last saw the torch in the wicker basket, Chidi last learned its location from Jonas’s text saying it was in the wicker basket, Soren last saw it in the white cabinet, and Keiko last saw it moved to the canvas sack. Jonas thinks Uma and Yara both saw his move to the green cupboard because he doesn’t know Yara missed it.

ANSWER: Quinn, Oksana, Chidi, Soren, Keiko

Viktor expects Goran to say **Room Birch**, because that’s what Goran told him in step 33. Ines later tells Viktor the booking is in Room Elm, but that message doesn’t tell him what Goran knows. Viktor doesn’t hear the later changes that Goran hears.

ANSWER: B

Yara secretly listens to the call in step 14 and sees that Viktor hears the booking read out as Room Dogwood. She never learns that Viktor receives or overhears any later updates, so she still thinks he believes the workshop is booked in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: A

On call 39, Ines sees that Zoltan and Yara both hear the workshop move to Room Dogwood. Yara hears it move to Room Birch on call 40, but Zoltan is absent. Ines therefore thinks Zoltan still believes Yara thinks it’s in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

On call 39, Bruno, Zoltan, Yara, and Mirela all hear the workshop move to Room Dogwood, and each can see who else is there. Zoltan is absent from both later calls, and Bruno has no reason to think Zoltan learned about either move. So Bruno thinks Zoltan still thinks Yara believes Mirela thinks the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

On call 5, Mirela saw that both Yara and Viktor heard the booking change to Room Alder. That is the last update Mirela knows Yara saw Viktor receive. Yara later secretly heard Viktor hear the Room Dogwood booking on call 14, but Mirela did not know Yara was listening.

So Mirela thinks Yara still thinks Viktor believes the workshop is booked in Room Alder.

ANSWER: A

Viktor last moves the harmonica to the tall tin. Hana later opens the tins and confirms it is there, and no one moves it afterward.

ANSWER: D

Uma believes the workshop is in Room Elm. Ines, Bruno, and Goran each told her it was in Elm, so as far as she knows, they already agree. Uma last knew Viktor to believe it was in Birch because she told him directly, and she last knew Mirela, Yara, and Zoltan to believe it was in Birch because they all heard Mirela say so on the call.

ANSWER: Viktor, Mirela, Yara, Zoltan

Goran last learns about the stopwatch from Viktor’s text, which says it is in the wicker basket. Goran does not see the final reveal, so his belief does not change.

ANSWER: C

Goran saw the stopwatch in the wicker basket through the window. Viktor’s later text confirmed that location, and Goran didn’t see the final reveal that it was in the blue drawer. So he opens the wicker basket first.

ANSWER: B

On call 5, Uma, Zoltan, Goran, and Yara all hear Ines move the workshop to Room Alder, and each can see who else heard it.

No later event updates the full chain of beliefs. For example, Zoltan and Uma hear Mirela tell Yara it’s in Room Birch on call 28, but they can see that Goran isn’t there. Uma misses the later calls that include Zoltan, Goran, and Yara, and the private messages she receives don’t tell her who else knows. So the nested belief remains Room Alder.

ANSWER: A

Yara’s public reveal of the torch in the wicker basket is the last update shared along the whole belief chain. Yara, Uma, Chidi, and Oksana were all in the cellar and could see that the others witnessed the reveal.

Oksana then left. Yara’s private text to Oksana about the canvas sack was not known to Uma or Chidi, and Uma did not know about Chidi’s later private messages. Those updates therefore don’t change what Yara thinks Uma thinks Chidi thinks Oksana thinks Yara believes.

ANSWER: D

After Xavier leaves the garage, Nadim texts him that the harmonica is in the tall tin. Xavier believes the message and receives no later information about the harmonica.

ANSWER: D

Keiko saw Chidi move the torch to the green cupboard while Uma was still in the cellar. She doesn’t know that Yara missed that move, so she thinks Yara would also take it as something Chidi knew Uma had seen.

Uma was outside when Yara moved the torch to the wicker basket, and Jonas’s text updating Uma was private. Keiko then missed Chidi’s move to the white cabinet. By the time the cabinet was opened in full view, Chidi had already left. So in Keiko’s view of the belief chain, the last location Chidi would think Keiko attributed to Uma was the green cupboard.

ANSWER: C

The chain points to the **wicker basket**. When Yara opens all four containers just after Chidi returns, everyone in the belief chain is present. They all see where the torch is and can see who else witnessed the reveal.

Oksana then leaves. Later sightings and messages change individual beliefs about the torch, but they don’t give Oksana a new basis for thinking that Chidi believes Uma saw it somewhere else. The outer layers of the chain have no reason to revise that belief either.

ANSWER: B

Xavier heard Hana announce that the stopwatch was in the wooden chest while Ines was in the garage. Ines left before the next move, and Xavier didn’t know she was watching through the window. So Xavier thinks Ines still believes it’s in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

Keiko knows that Quinn saw Chidi leave after the torch was put in the green cupboard but before Uma moved it. Keiko privately told Chidi about the move, but Quinn doesn’t know she did. So, as far as Keiko thinks Quinn knows, Uma thinks Jonas thinks Keiko still takes Chidi to believe the torch is in the green cupboard.

Keiko doesn’t know about Quinn’s later observations through the window, and Quinn’s text to Keiko gives only a location, not an update about what anyone else believes.

ANSWER: C
